text: dsh-access-review-proof 是面向 DSH 的离线权限复核证据核验插件，通过 DSH 工具接收明确提供的复核清单，检查 entitlement 覆盖、按风险要求的分阶段决定、复核者独立性、keep/revoke 决定与 closure 是否一致，以及复核后清单是否匹配并保持新鲜。inspect 工具概览清单哈希与数量，verify 工具生成脱敏且内容寻址的报告。适合需要核对已提交权限复核材料是否闭合的场景；代码未要求 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-access-review-proof is an offline DSH plugin that checks supplied review evidence for coverage, required decision stages, matching closures, and a fresh post-review inventory. Its tools inspect or verify a manifest and write a redacted report. No API key or external service is required.
想核对一份权限复核材料有没有覆盖清单里的全部 entitlement。
帮我检查权限复核的 keep/revoke 决定和实际闭合状态是否一致。
I need to verify whether an access review has a matching post-review inventory snapshot.
dsh-access-review-proof 的功能「复核闭合核验」：verify 检查清单覆盖、分阶段决定、closure 状态与复核后 snapshot，并写出核验报告。

dsh-access-review-proof README · dsh-access-review-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence for one narrow question: **does the supplied access-review campaign cover every declared entitlement, satisfy its risk-based review stages, and close each keep/revoke decision into a fresh post-review inventory?**

dsh-access-review-proof README · dsh-access-review-proof：The same headless core is exposed as a DSH bundle, standalone MCP stdio server, JavaScript API and CLI. Reports are redacted, content-addressed and verified after writing.

dsh-access-review-proof README · Complementary boundary：Microsoft Entra access reviews govern and recertify access to groups, applications, access packages and roles. This plugin only verifies supplied structured evidence; it is not an identity-governance platform.

dsh-access-review-proof README · Complementary boundary：- `dsh-principal-binding-proof` verifies which authority and principal an evidence chain binds.
- `dsh-policy-waiver-proof` verifies a declared policy exception.
- `dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof` verifies closure of one emergency-access session.
- This plugin checks a complete declared entitlement inventory, staged reviewer decisions, applied keep/revoke closure and a post-review snapshot.

dsh-access-review-proof README · Complementary boundary：It never approves, keeps or revokes access; authenticates receipts; queries live identity infrastructure; or proves the supplied inventory contains every real entitlement. A supplied closure or snapshot is evidence to authenticate elsewhere.

npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-access-review-proof.mjs inspect examples/closed.json
node bin/dsh-access-review-proof.mjs verify examples/closed.json

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-access-review-proof
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-access-review-proof#<commit>
```

DSH tools are `dsh_access_review_inspect` and `dsh_access_review_verify`. MCP tools are `access_review_inspect` and `access_review_verify`.

dsh-access-review-proof README · Use：See [`examples/closed.json`](examples/closed.json). Only public IDs, timestamps, counts and SHA-256 bindings belong in a manifest. Never put credentials, account names, tokens, raw identity exports or business text in it.

dsh-access-review-proof README · dsh-access-review-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

这是一个离线、确定性的 DSH 证据层，只回答一个窄问题：**显式提供的权限复核活动，是否覆盖全部已声明 entitlement、满足风险分级复核，并把每个保留/撤销决定闭合到新鲜的复核后清单？**

同一个无界面核心同时提供 DSH bundle、独立 MCP stdio、JavaScript API 和 CLI；报告脱敏、内容寻址，并在写后回读。

dsh-access-review-proof README · 互补边界：Microsoft Entra access reviews 用于治理和再认证 group、application、access package 与 role 权限。本插件只核验 supplied structured evidence，不是身份治理平台。

- `dsh-principal-binding-proof` 核验证据链绑定的 authority/principal；
- `dsh-policy-waiver-proof` 核验声明的策略例外；
- `dsh-break-glass-settlement-proof` 核验单次紧急访问会话闭合；
- 本插件核验一份已声明 entitlement 清单的分阶段决定、keep/revoke 落地闭合和复核后 snapshot。

它不会审批、保留或撤销权限，不认证回执、不查询线上身份系统，也不证明 supplied inventory 包含现实中的全部权限。closure 和 snapshot 仍只是待外部认证的显式证据。

dsh-access-review-proof README · 核验项：- review 起止、due date、closure、snapshot、evaluation 时序；
- 已声明 entitlement 集合的精确覆盖；
- 按风险要求的 stage 数与连续有序决定；
- 配置为高风险时的 reviewer 独立性和禁止自审；
- decisions、closures、snapshot 的同一 review binding；
- 每个 entitlement 恰好一条复核完成后的 closure；
- 最终 `keep`/`revoke` 与 `active`/`revoked` 一致；
- 撤销决定必须有非零 application receipt；
- snapshot 中 active/revoked 对全部已声明权限精确分区；
- 观察者多样性、证据新鲜度；
- 拒绝秘密/raw 字段、workspace 限界、symlink 防护、内容寻址回读。
